title: Command to a node
description: Sent by the service on topgun/<team>/<esp32|vision>/<node_id>/cmd. All fields optional; a node ignores fields it does not understand.

action.description: Default 'set'. 'capture' asks the vision node to analyse a tray now.

batch_id.description: Switch the node to this batch.

outputs.description: Actuator name -> level 0-100 (PWM duty %), e.g. fan_pct, led_pct, buzzer_pct.
